claims: Quadrupole vibrations about axially deformed spheroidal equilibrium decompose into axial-preserving beta-vibrations (K=0) and axial-breaking gamma-vibrations (K=2); the two-phonon gamma state strictly splits into K=0 and K=4 rotational bandheads under Bose symmetry.

The double-commutator theorem provides model-independent energy-weighted sum rules (EWSR) evaluated from ground-state densities, yielding the TRK E1 integrated cross section 60 NZ/A MeV mb, the ISGQR E2 sum rule 25.7 Z A^(2/3) MeV e^2 fm^4, and the breathing mode E0 sum rule directly constraining nuclear incompressibility K_inf ~ 230 MeV.

The Mottelson-Valatin Coriolis anti-pairing (CAP) mechanism describes the second-order phase transition from the pairing superfluid state to the normal rigid-rotor Fermi gas as Coriolis forces quench the pairing gap Delta(omega) = Delta_0 [1 - (omega/omega_crit)^2]^(1/2).

The Strutinsky shell correction method superimposing macroscopic liquid-drop energy and smoothed single-particle shell fluctuations explains the double-humped fission barriers (E_A, E_B) and microsecond-lived shape isomers in the actinides.
